scope: Partial notification permission and blocked DM creation regression verification
result: An open notification settings panel reflects external permission changes without requesting permission or changing account preferences. New direct-message channel creation is rejected for blocked relationships and block lookup failures while existing history remains accessible. Client and server targeted tests, broader DM/block tests, lint, TypeScript and Go vet passed.
limitations: The DM creation check does not establish atomic behavior when blocking and creation occur concurrently. Real browser notification behavior and full multi-user privacy acceptance remain open.
